_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The test shrinks the app's tail-first mounting so that a 15-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} spans many chunks: on load only the last few chunks mount (as ".messages-chunk" elements) and older history renders as placeholders ([data-testid="pending-chunk"]). "The counts" are pending = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pending-chunk"]').length and mounted = document.querySelectorAll('.messages-chunk').length. "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s), then wait until the LAST element matching [data-testid="message"] is visible (its getBoundingClientRect() has a non-zero width and height; allow 30s). The test has already set the shelley.tailFirstTest knob; do not set it yourself. Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. Wait with such steps and a timeout, not with polling loops inside the expression. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable in a separate eval with "expect". Perform the steps in order. A table-of-contents jump into unmounted history mounts the target chunk; the background sweep is off.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Record the counts: window.__before = {pending, mounted}. window.__before.pending must be greater than 0.
3. Click the table of contents button (".toc-button"), then click the first TOC entry (".toc-entry") whose text contains "Turn 1:" (the first user turn, whose chunk is a placeholder).
4. Wait until mounted is greater than window.__before.mounted (allow 15s).
5. The highlighted target (".message-highlight") is in the viewport, clipped by the scrolling messages container like Playwright's toBeInViewport (assert_in_viewport, allow 15s): the mount and jump landed on it.

steps.expression: (() => { const msgs = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]'); if (!msgs.length) return false; const last = msgs[msgs.length - 1]; const r = last.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()
